other_text: ROLLAND PICTURE PLAYS COMPANY Presenting Margarita Fischer in "The Devil's Assistant" A wonderfully original story, presenting the most fascinating and original character ever produced on the screen. The story of a girl who sold her soul to the devil for beauty and wealth. She wins the love of a man, but loses her soul.
description: A vintage movie poster features a woman pointing dramatically with occult imagery and text promoting "The Devil's Assistant" starring Margarita Fischer.
